import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (main plot)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0:2, 0:2])
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(sensor_types))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Brand distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8)
ax2.barh(range(len(brand_counts)), brand_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('viridis', len(brand_counts)))
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(brand_counts)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(brand_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 8 Brands', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. 4K Video capability distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
video_4k_counts = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
colors_pie = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff']
ax3.pie(video_4k_counts.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=colors_pie)
ax3.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Price distribution by Body Type
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
body_types = df['body_type'].value_counts().head(5).index
data_to_plot = [df[df['body_type'] == bt]['price_usd'].dropna() for bt in body_types]
bp = ax4.boxplot(data_to_plot, labels=body_types, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], sns.color_palette('Set2', len(body_types))):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax4.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Weight vs Price relationship
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax5.hexbin(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], gridsize=30, cmap='YlOrRd', mincnt=1)
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Price Density', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Average price trend over years
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
yearly_avg = df.groupby('model_year')['price_usd'].mean().sort_index()
ax6.plot(yearly_avg.index, yearly_avg.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, color='#2E86AB', markersize=4)
ax6.fill_between(yearly_avg.index, yearly_avg.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax6.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Avg Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Average Price Trend', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis - Comprehensive Overview', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
